name: Pluckhavoc
description: Start the first orbit with a low swing and keep the second orbit in reserve at the shoulder.

name: Murk Cordloop
description: The off-hand cord mirrors the guard hand and turns aside a blow from the weaker flank.

name: Torrent Reelin
description: Sidestep so that one orbit passes in front of the user and the other behind.

name: Dartneck Vigil
description: Count the beat of both orbits through the cord until the user feels any break in their rhythm.

name: Tinenerve
description: Two orbits turn in a ring about the user and keep every strike from reaching the body.

name: Sanguine Loopcast
description: Snap both orbits across each other so the dart takes the opponent from two directions.

name: Hoarfrost Darttip
description: Pass the turning dart from one hand to the other through a wrapped limb to bind it fast.

name: Pluckvalor
description: Rings turning against each other shear apart any weapon that enters between them.

name: Tempered Flickhand
description: Dive both orbits in on the same point so the dart pierces where one alone would glance.

name: Facet Whipout
description: Collapse both orbits through a single point and the dart breaks plate and the shock opens the body behind it.

name: Hoarfrost Cordlength
description: Fix the gaze on a single point of the foe and send the dart there without moving the eyes.

name: Remnant Dartblade
description: Mark the foe's weakest side while the cord hangs quiet and the field spreads wide.

name: Gustspool
description: Dip a shoulder and slide away from the line of a thrust with the dart already turning.

name: Torrent Ringend
description: Perch the cord on the forearm as a hawk perches and let it flick a blow away.

name: Overpowering Cordknot
description: A loop closes on the foe's wrist with the quickness of a talon grasping.

name: Spiralcast Ruin
description: Let the dart circle overhead and fall from whichever side the foe watches least.

name: Unbudging Tailring
description: Spread the cord like a pinion and let it screen the whole front from darts and stones.

name: Chime Snapback
description: Snatch a blade from a lifted hand with a loop that closes like a talon on its prey.

name: Gust Retrieve
description: Climb a short rise on the cord's hold and arrive above the foe's reach.

name: Drilltine
description: The dart plunges point-first with a rush of qi behind it and drives through a raised shield.

name: Predatory Cordlength
description: A net of cord is laid over an approach and drops upon those who walk beneath it.

name: Hour Reelin
description: Flash down the cord's whole line in one instant and strike with the dart on arrival at the far end.

name: Eviscerating Retrieve
description: The dart drifts toward the foe as slow water drifts and gathers speed only at the end.

name: Spoolvalor
description: Turn the cord in a small eddy before the body so a strike swirls off to the side.

name: Thrumblink
description: Take stones-and-pools steps across broken ground without tangling the trailing cord.

name: Gyvepluck
description: Drag a snared leg backward by slow steady pulls until the foe loses his stance.

name: Charter Dartblade
description: Hold the cord in a still deep curve so that blows sink into it and lose their force.

name: Blaze Cordwinder
description: Whip the dart in short fast beats like rapids breaking over rock against the opponent's guard.

name: Darttip Ruin
description: Surge the charged cord across a broad front so everything at its height is struck as by a flood.

name: Thorn Tailring
description: Wind the cord in a tightening whirl about the foe until every arm and leg is drawn in.

name: Maiming Fastening Loopcast
description: A last slow wrap closes about the foe and holds the whole body still as deep water holds a stone.

name: Glint Flickhand
description: Lob the dart high on a steep arc so it falls where the foe expects nothing.

name: Charter Cordloop
description: Cross the cord above the head to hold off a blow that comes down from higher ground.

name: Mightpluck
description: Step down a slope in long balanced strides while the dart hangs ready on its cord.

name: Waning Dartneck
description: Sight against the horizon to learn how much the foe stands above or below the user.

name: Ponderous Cordwinder
description: Hook a loop over a ledge or beam and pull the foe against it.

name: Iron Cordknot
description: Let the full weight of the dart fall from a height onto the foe's lowered head or shoulder.

name: Might Spiralcast
description: Climb a wall or tree hand over hand on the cord anchored by the dart above.

name: Hoarfrost Dartblade
description: Spin the cord flat above the head to shed falling stones and arrows.

name: Novapluck
description: Drop the charged dart from the top of its climb so the point strikes as a falling spike.

name: Tinevalor
description: Rig a loop high on a branch or beam and let it fall when the foe passes under.

name: Berserk Whipout
description: Rise to the zenith of the throw and plunge the dart down through guard and armor together.

name: Chime Reelin
description: Throw the first course at the chest and hold the second back along the cord.

name: Flintlike Ringend
description: Hold two lines of cord side by side so a blade that slips one meets the other.

name: Thrumglare
description: Shift from one course to the other in a single step without breaking the cord's turn.

name: Revitalizing Cordknot
description: Feel the tension along both courses and know which one the foe is straining against.

name: Immobilizing Cordlength
description: Slip two loops over a wrist and let the second catch what the first lets go.

name: Merciless Ringend
description: Cross both courses on the foe's centerline so the dodge from one runs into the other.

name: Unrelenting Dartneck
description: Weave the two courses in front of the body in a closed pattern against thrusts.

name: Gyvethrum
description: Pull with one hand and ease with the other so the snared foe is turned about.

name: Glamour Flickhand
description: Retreat on one course while the other still threatens so the foe pursues the wrong dart.

name: Pluckwrath
description: Send two darts after a dodging foe so the second lands where the first drove him.

name: Thorn Cordwinder
description: Lay two parallel snares across a path so that avoiding one brings the foot into the other.

name: Spoolruin
description: Reverse the courses at the moment of contact and snap qi through the dart into the new line.

name: Shattering Gust Whipout
description: Both courses arrive on the foe in the same instant and the paired blow breaks the guard.

name: Nova Darttip
description: Throw along the lip of an imagined rim so the dart skims a curve to the foe.

name: Equipoise Tailring
description: Spread the cord like a river meeting the sea so a blow disperses across its width.

name: Torrential Snapback
description: Walk the rim of the foe's reach and never step inside it without the cord leading.

name: Chime Cordknot
description: Read the foe's breathing through the cord as one reads a reed bed for hidden movement.

name: Maiming Cordloop
description: Hook the foe's belt on the rim of a loop and pull him down to the dart.

name: Eviscerating Ringend
description: Run the dart along the foe's flank in a long even lash like a river along its bank.

name: Pluckdurance
description: Hold the cord as a bank holds a river and let blows spend themselves against it.

name: Retrieve Devastation
description: Pour stored qi down the cord and out through the dart as a spillway pours a full channel.

name: Gyvetine
description: Close a wide ring of cord about the foe and draw it inward step by step.

name: Might Cordloop
description: Strike with the dart along the rim and let the cord's pull take the foe along the river to the wrap.

name: Decimating Darttip
description: Cast the dart into the wind's flow across the plateau so it comes round upon the foe.

name: Attuned Cordlength
description: Stand with the cord loose and watch how the wind moves it before the foe moves.

name: Pluckglare
description: Sweep wide on open ground with the dart trailing so the foe cannot corner the user.

name: Unbowed Tailring
description: Turn with a gust and let the cord ride it to brush a strike away.

name: Overpowering Snapback
description: Throw a loop sworn to find its mark and close the moment it touches the arm.

name: Ironthrum
description: Crack the dart down the wind's line so it strikes with the weight of the gust.

name: Iron Flickhand
description: Hold the cord taut and fast against every gust and blow without a falter of the hand.

name: Torrent Cordwinder
description: Spring into the gale with the cord trailing and land on the far side of the foe.

name: Gnashing Reelin
description: Drive the charged dart down a gust so it reaches a foe far past any plain throw.

name: Silt Dartneck
description: Peg several tethers across a stretch of grass and let the wind hide the cord.

name: Facet Spiralcast
description: Cast the dart down a sworn line in the full strength of the gale and pierce through the guard.

name: Gust Loopcast
description: Cast on the sworn bearing so the dart's line is already fixed when it leaves the hand.

name: Thrumdurance
description: Hold the guard along the bearing so a blow from the side must cross the whole cord.

name: Blinding Whipout
description: Hold the heading with each step and let the foe turn aside first.

name: Overbearing Spiralcast
description: Cinch a wrap on the foe's wrist along the bearing so it cannot be slid off.

name: Hoarfrost Cordloop
description: Keep the cord spinning on its bearing so no strike can cross it unspent.

name: Lacerating Snapback
description: Thrust the dart on its bearing without turning the wrist so the point stays true.

name: Tempered Cordlength
description: The dart follows a dodging foe on the same bearing and is recalled only when it has struck.

name: Silt Cordknot
description: Stake a snare on the bearing the foe must follow and tighten it as they come.

name: Reelinscourge
description: Drive the dart home along the sworn line and let the cord wrap close behind it.

name: Vengeful Retrieve
description: Cast with the wind from the edge read first so the dart is thrown into its lean.

name: Dazzling Snapback
description: Set each foot with care at the drop of an edge and shift weight against the cord.

name: Unassailable Cordwinder
description: Slide a blade along the taut cord like a rail so it passes the body at its side.

name: Reelinnerve
description: A loop thrown to the lip of the edge catches a heel that comes too near.

name: Remnant Tailring
description: Read the gale's direction through the dart's sway before committing the cast.

name: Sanguine Retrieve
description: Let the gale carry the dart round again on the return so it strikes twice.

name: Spiralcast Flash
description: Hang over the edge on the cord and swing in below the foe's guard.

name: Invincible Dartblade
description: Brace into the gale on the cord and hold ground against a rush from upwind.

name: Thrumspine
description: Snap the snare shut at the lip and drag the foe down on his face.

name: Reelinwrath
description: Feed qi into the gale's push and let the dart arc beyond the foe's reach and return.

name: Septic Ringend
description: Hide a taut cord along the edge's lip so a stepping foe is thrown off the rim.

name: Unsparing Reelin
description: Reckon wind and drop together and bring the dart onto the foe with the finality of a fall.

name: Nova Loopcast
description: Cast under open sky with the full length of the cord given to the throw.

name: Impervious Darttip
description: Parry with no wall behind the user and let the cord carry the blow far wide.

name: Tineflash
description: Step on the moving shadow of a cloud so the foe loses the user's place for a breath.

name: Buoying Dartneck
description: Hold the cord loose and watch the whole horizon for any second foe approaching.

name: Pluckspine
description: Sweep a wide loop across open ground and close it on whichever limb it meets.

name: Merciless Flickhand
description: Whirl the dart with the full room of the open air and strike from the arc's far side.

name: Charter Cordlength
description: Spin the cord until its wind itself turns away darts and arrows.

name: Chime Whipout
description: Cast the charged dart to the very end of the cord and an arm's length beyond it.

name: Thorn Darttip
description: Spread a cord mesh over open ground so a mounted charge falls into its folds.

name: Thrumruin
description: Bring the dart down out of the open sky in one fall that no wall could have stopped.

name: Blistering Cordwinder
description: Take a bearing then let the wind alter it in the throw so the dart curves in.

name: Murk Dartblade
description: Turn the guard with each shift of the wind and let the cord ride the change.

name: Cordloop Whirlpool
description: Step windward and keep the foe between the user and the downwind drift of the dart.

name: Chime Dartneck
description: Check the held bearing against the dart's hang to see how far the wind has pushed.

name: Maiming Spiralcast
description: Close a loop in the lull between gusts when the foe cannot see it move.

name: Blistering Dartblade
description: Throw across a gust so the dart curves from the side the foe has forgotten.

name: Granite Cordknot
description: Hold a line of cord on the bearing so it stands before the body like a fixed bar.

name: Reelinflash
description: Slide across the quartering wind and arrive beside the foe's blind shoulder.

name: Overbearing Flickhand
description: Let a gust finish the wrap of the cord about the foe's wrist before the user pulls.

name: Unsparing Ringend
description: Push qi against the wind on the dart's return so it strikes harder for the resistance.

name: Toxinspool
description: Peg a snare on the lee side of a rise where a pursuing foe will not look.

name: Reelinruin
description: Let the veering wind swing the dart round after a foe who thought himself clear.

name: Boltspool
description: Hold the bearing against a full turn of the wind and let the dart close from the one side left open.

name: Blazespool
description: Throw along the thin high rim so the dart rides the updraft over the foe's shoulder.

name: Charter Flickhand
description: Spin the cord in thin cold air to keep the guard turning without wasted effort.

name: Dazzling Retrieve
description: Take short steps on loose high ground so the footing never gives under the pull.

name: Ringend Vitality
description: Feel the updraft lift the cord to learn where the wind is strongest on the ridge.

name: Whipout Obduracy
description: Hook the cord on a ridge rock and let the foe run into its taut line.

name: Reelinhavoc
description: Run along the ridge with the dart lashing out at each pass of the foe.

name: Adamantine Cordwinder
description: Hold the cord as a screen on the crest and let wind and blows flow around it.

name: Might Reelin
description: Sling the cord about a rock and swing down a face in a single controlled drop.

name: Grievous Loopcast
description: Drive the charged dart down a ridge wind until its point splits a shield rim.

name: Silt Dartblade
description: Stretch snare lines across a narrow ridge pass so that none may cross unseen.

name: Gnashing Spiralcast Wrath
description: Cast from the highest ground and let the dart fall with the weight of the whole plateau behind it.
